data.action: 单手斜持巨剑垂于焦痕地面，嘴角微扬自信而立
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, 七分身牛仔景，焦黑地面、剑身与自信神态清晰
data.description: 训练结束后的战术演武场内，地面留着几道炽热灼烧后的焦黑划痕，空气中弥漫着淡淡余烟。史尔特尔单手将莱瓦汀斜垂在身侧，嘴角泛起一抹自信的浅笑，清晨阳光穿透高处的气窗洒在战靴旁。
data.lighting: 高排工业采光窗斜射入室的清晨冷白晨光
data.location: 罗德岛地下战术演武场
data.promptProse: In a spacious industrial training dojo with scorched impact craters on the floor, Surtr holds her massive sword lowered at her side with cool confidence. Fresh pale morning sunlight slants through high industrial windows across the drifting smoke.
data.title: 史尔特尔 · 演武场焦痕处的歇息
data.animaCaption: Holding her greatsword angled toward the scorched floor with a subtle smirk, she stands amidst lingering smoke in the morning light.
